subject: a compact rabbit integrated with a spinning-top base
pose: leaning slightly with one ear folded and one upright
art_direction: 瓷兔坐在短陀螺底上旋转，双耳一折一竖，青釉与橙色底环形成精细又可读的动感。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Sculpt a small porcelain rabbit whose lower body merges into a short spinning-top base. The rabbit leans a few degrees, with one ear upright and the other folded inward to keep the silhouette compact. Its face has two tiny calm eyes and a minimal mouth, suggesting serene playfulness. Use pale celadon glaze on the body and a warm orange ring around the top base. Render subtle glaze pooling, a fine foot shadow, and one controlled blurred reflection beneath the spinning point, while keeping the rabbit itself sharp. Set it against muted slate-blue. The complete figure fits the safe circular area of the square, with no additional toys, lettering, or decorative speed streaks.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
